biggest_catch: Official pay ('up to $0.60/audio minute') and official Friday payouts are confirmed, but no official figures exist for how many active working minutes an audio minute takes - so the real hourly wage cannot be established from official sources.
catches: 'Up to $0.60/audio minute' is a cap: actual rate depends on your transcriber rating and project difficulty.
Pay is per audio minute, never per working minute - and no official page states the working-time conversion.
Projects are first-come, first-served; work availability varies with client demand.
Poor-audio files pay the same per minute but take longer - preview before claiming.

eligibility: No experience required; pass GoTranscript's transcription test and follow their guidelines; hires worldwide.
maximize: GoTranscript is rejected here because no official figures exist for active working time per audio minute - don't trust third-party hourly-wage claims. Its official pay (up to $0.60/audio minute) and Friday payouts with no minimum are documented; if official time figures ever appear, cherry-pick short clear-audio files to maximize effective hourly pay.
notes: Official pay ('up to $0.60 per transcription minute') and official timing (every Friday, PayPal/Payoneer, no minimum) are documented, but no official active-work-time figures exist. Rev's official transcription-speed page is Rev's own data and cannot stand in for GoTranscript's.
numeric_basis: backfill: Rejected - no official active-work-time figures (up to $0.60/audio min pay official)
payout_quote: Official GoTranscript guide: 'For every minute of transcription, you can earn up to 60 cents.' A representative 10-audio-minute file pays up to $6.00. Audio minutes are NOT working minutes, and no official page states the conversion to active working time.
payout_value_note: 'up to $0.60/audio minute' official; floor $0 per 'up to' convention; active time not officially stated

steps: Sign up on GoTranscript and study their transcription guidelines.
Pass the transcription test to join the freelancer team.
Claim projects from the work board (first-come, first-served).
Get paid every Friday via PayPal or Payoneer with no minimum payout.
timing: Official: 'Every Friday, GoTranscript sends out payments to its transcribers... There's no minimum amount to cash out.' PayPal or Payoneer.
